prompts.title: Recent Form: Wins, Draws and Losses
prompts.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 seconds, for recent form. Layout: charcoal #101412 background with a subtle slate #8ca6bf grid at low opacity. Top third holds title 'Forma reciente' in warm white #edf0e6, with subtitle 'Últimos partidos' in slate. Middle two-thirds: grouped count bars on a shared zero baseline. The count axis is labelled by the renderer using the fact unit; the categorical axis shows two teams, 'Suiza' and 'Macedonia del Norte'. Each team has three bars for 'Victorias', 'Empates' and 'Derrotas'. Use lime #c5ed74 for Suiza bars and slate #8ca6bf for Macedonia bars, with warm white value labels above each bar. Render Suiza victories as {{home.wins}}, draws as {{home.draws}}, losses as {{home.losses}}; Macedonia victories as {{away.wins}}, draws as {{away.draws}}, losses as {{away.losses}}. Add sample chips: 'Muestra Suiza: {{home.n}}' and 'Muestra Macedonia del Norte: {{away.n}}', with units resolved by the renderer. If samples differ, keep the same zero baseline and annotate the difference; do not normalise counts. Entry animation: title fades in, grid draws, bars grow upward in staggered order. Main comparison: Suiza bar group versus Macedonia bar group. Emphasis: pulse the highest bar in each group and draw a thin lime underline under any zero-count bar to show absence. Source annotation above the subtitle safe area: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra según chips'. Camera: slow vertical push-in. Transition: slate wipe to next scene. Exit: bars collapse to baseline. Reserve lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; do not place graphics there. Keep one focal point, legible Spanish labels and professional hierarchy. No predictive claims.
